about: A policy is four weights and nothing else: what a cell is worth to look at next is its reach, how together its claims arrived, what stands beside it and what it still leaves free.

Over one field, four specialists and one mixed policy: the two that weigh only reach or only what stands beside a cell pile on a single cell and close nothing; the two that weigh width or coherence close almost everything.

The mixed policy closes more than any specialist and forks fewer times than either of the ones that close, which is the whole claim: four weights beat one, and the relation is the law while the counts belong to whoever reproduces them.

cases.name: sixty cells, a hundred and twenty looks
